description:
FILED s473t1 (Opus, the 13-file early-stop triage).  Not a new bug -- a
MEASUREMENT of the flip's cost that the not-supported.md wording understates.

docs/not-supported.md ('Lvalue subroutines') says the run-time die "costs only
the rows at or after the statement inside its own top-level form".  True, and
that form can be the WHOLE FILE.

MEASURED, perl-tests/method.t.  One drop at line 72:

    PCL: statement dropped at method.t line 72:
      is((method $obj "a","b","c"), "method,a,b,c");
      -- Bug. Fell through. Missing case: ['Token::Symbol<$obj>','Token::Quote::Double<"a">']

(the ruled indirect-object non-support, docs/not-supported.md 'Indirect object
syntax with a SCALAR invocant', USER decision s425.)  `my $obj = bless [],
"Pack"` at line 66 lowers to a `p-let` whose BODY is the rest of $obj's scope,
so the emitted CL has ONE top-level form spanning lines 66-199 (verified with
SBCL's own reader: form #315, CL lines 773-1001 -- a textual "^(" scan gets
this WRONG, the emitter writes some NESTED forms at column 0).  The die at
line 72 therefore costs 35 assertions, lines 72 through 199, not 1.

method.t: 124 of 163 rows, shortfall 65 = 35 (this) + 26 skip_if_miniperl
(task #1439) + 2 stale plan (task #1438) + 1 task #1434 + 1 task #1435.

WHAT TO DO.  Options, in increasing cost: (a) say so in not-supported.md (done
in s473t1) so nobody reads "its own top-level form" as "one statement"; (b)
make the drop-census / flip-gate arithmetic count ROWS BEHIND A DROP, not
drops -- 1 drop is 35 rows here and 44 in substr.t; (c) narrow the emitted
form: a file-level `my` whose later uses are all at top level does not need a
`p-let` spanning the rest of the file (this is the s470-era global-partition
machinery, so it is not free).  No option is scheduled.
subject: The announce->DIE flip's BLAST RADIUS is the enclosing TOP-LEVEL FORM, and a file-level `my` makes that the rest of the file: perl-tests/method.t loses 35 assertions to ONE drop
